backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing each frontend file's purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining theme variables, dark mode tokens, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling simple navigation, layout, and global WhatsApp chat button.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Consul: Consultation section with contact cards, WhatsApp link, and a frontend-only form.
frontend/src/components/marketing/IconCa: Reusable marketing card displaying an icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Pricin: Reusable pricing card with feature lists, optional 'Most Popular' badge, and CTA.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Proces: Four-step process display with icons for consultation, design, development, and launch.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteFo: Footer with branding, navigation links, contact info, and WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteHe: Renders a sticky site header with navigation buttons and a scroll-to-consultation action.
frontend/src/components/marketing/WhatsA: Provides a fixed WhatsApp chat button linking to a preset number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider and hook for login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, fonts, color variables, gradients, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the homepage with a hero section, benefits, visuals, and consultation call-to-actions.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Shows pricing tiers with feature lists and additional info sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, shadows, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s schema, goals, design direction, required pages, and existing implemented features for a 2‑page Webraft marketing site. Contains architectural notes, requirements, and metadata for build planning.
